proxyAccountingNote: Primary values and sorting use proxy traffic only; parentheses show all traffic, including DIRECT.
unknownOutboundNote: Some records lack final outbound information. They are included only in the inclusive totals and are not classified as proxy or DIRECT.
noProxyResults: No applications with proxy traffic match the current filters.
summaryFollowsFilters: Follows the current filters; parentheses include DIRECT.
chartProxyScope: This chart shows proxy traffic only.
proxyChartEmpty: No proxy traffic was recorded for this period.
chartAllScope: This chart shows all traffic, including DIRECT.
recentWindowNote: Short views focus on the latest recorded period; earlier hourly records are shown in full.
nonLinearNote: The Y axis is nonlinear. Both smooth boundaries pass through the samples; hover for original byte values.
nonLinearCompact: Nonlinear Y axis; hover for original values.
chartKeyboardHint: Use arrow keys to inspect data and Escape to dismiss
exportHint: Export all filtered, sorted results, including pinned rows and all pages. Numeric values are saved in bytes.
exportDurationBound: Proxy duration is a lower bound
processHint: Enable application recognition to identify new connections. Existing unidentified traffic remains under Unknown application.
historyError: Could not read or save traffic history. Existing history was preserved.
samplingNote: Counts are estimates based on sampled connections. Recording continues while Clash Verge is running.
empty: No traffic has been recorded yet. New connections will appear here.
noResults: No applications or chains match the search.
expandHint: Double-click an application to view details.
chartEmpty: No recorded traffic for this month.
chartNote: Each bar shows sampled traffic across all chains. Unrecorded days are marked with a dash; hover a day for details.
durationHint: Estimated time with at least one sampled connection for this application and chain on the selected day. Overlapping connections are counted once. Older records may be incomplete.
durationIncomplete: Older history has no recorded time; the shown time is a lower bound.
clearDayConfirm: Delete traffic history for {{day}}? This cannot be undone.
clearAllConfirm: Delete all recorded traffic history? This cannot be undone.
wslDescription: Identify only WSL connections already entering Clash, without changing WSL network or proxy settings. WSL2 NAT, routing and short connections may prevent some traffic or app identification.
wslRoot: A read-only probe runs as root to identify TCP and connected UDP processes; python3, ss and ip are required.
wslErrorHint: Check that the selected WSL distribution is running and python3, ss and ip are available.
columnsHint: Right-click or click to choose visible columns
wslIpMissing: Could not read WSL network addresses; app identification requires the ip command.
wslTunQuestion: WSL monitoring requires Clash TUN. Enabling TUN changes system network routing; WSL2 NAT and routing can still prevent traffic or app identification. WSL network and proxy settings are not changed.
wslTunFailed: TUN could not be enabled; WSL monitoring has not started.
trendNote: Smooth stacked areas show upload below download. Missing samples remain gaps. The 1-day view uses 5-second records, 3 days uses 3-hour totals, and week/month views use daily totals.
hourlyHistoryNote: Recovered usage without reliable timestamps is listed separately in the 1-day view and included in longer-range totals.
legacyHour: This hour includes hourly data and is shown as an hourly total
groupDurationHint: Chains may be active at the same time; the longest chain duration is shown as a lower bound.
diagnosticsNote: Recognition uses recorded evidence and exact system socket matches for active connections. Domains do not establish application ownership. Ended connections may have no recoverable name or PID.
diagnosticsEmpty: No diagnostic details for this date. Earlier records did not store destinations; new samples will appear here.
reasonWslProcess: Matched to WSL; no unique process found
reasonMissingEndpoints: Connection lacks endpoints needed for process matching
reasonProcess: No process matched; origin is undetermined
trendEmpty: No detailed records for this time range.
wslNatUnavailable: Windows NAT sessions are unavailable; WSL2 NAT application identification may be incomplete.
wslWaitingStart: The selected WSL distribution is not running. Monitoring starts when it is launched; Automatic monitors the first running distribution. This app does not start WSL.
processInfoError: Could not read current process information.
processLiveNote: This is the current running state, not proof of historical connection ownership. Name matches are candidates only. Up to 32 processes are shown.
reasonInternal: Internal Clash connection; the original application was not supplied.
chartResolutionNote: One day uses 5-second records; 3 days use 3-hour buckets; week and month use daily totals.
storageNote: SQLite records at 5-second resolution. History is retained until you clear it. Backups contain committed records and can be made while recording.
storageCompactNote: Reclaim space after clearing records; existing history is preserved. The operation may take some time for large databases.
recoveryNote: After sleep, a disconnection or an application restart, cumulative connection counters can recover usage whose exact timing is unknown. These bytes are included in daily and monthly totals and listed separately here. Existing 5-second records remain in the chart. The hour identifies when the difference was observed.
recoveryChartEmpty: This range has recovered totals but no timed samples. View the recovery details below.
mergedPathsNote: Versions of the same installed application are combined. Different installation roots and package publishers stay separate. The paths and current processes below help verify this grouping.
chartStale: Refresh failed; showing the last successful result. Click to retry.
recentHint: Adapts to the distribution of recent proxy activity, currently about {{minutes}} minutes, covering at least 5 minutes. Pinned applications stay visible. Idle connections do not refresh activity. This filters applications; daily and monthly totals keep their selected periods.
recentHistorical: Recent activity applies to today. Historical dates retain complete records; the preference resumes when you return to today.
recentEmpty: No matching recent proxy activity. Turn off Recent activity to see complete records.
internalAppNote: This internal connection was initiated by Clash / Mihomo itself and has no external application owner. It is categorized separately.
iconFallbackHint: {{name}}: the native icon is unavailable; showing an application name marker.
processSameInstallation: Current version of the same installed application
storageFileSizeHint: Size of the main SQLite file. Write-ahead logs and other storage are shown in Record management.
manualUpdatesNote: Download the complete portable package, or choose Replace and install to download, verify, review the paths, and restart with the replacement. Settings, subscriptions and traffic history stay in AppData.
upstreamVersion: Based on Clash Verge Rev {{version}} dev
updateCheckFailed: Could not check releases. Check your connection and try again, or open the releases page.
noPublishedRelease: No Windows portable release has been published yet.
replaceConfirmNote: Install {{version}}. Review the paths below. After confirmation the program will exit normally, replace its files and restart. Proxy connections will be interrupted briefly.
replacePermissionNote: The helper requests Windows administrator approval when needed. If replacement fails, it attempts to restore the previous files. Settings, subscriptions and the traffic database are preserved.
prepareUpdateNote: This step only downloads, verifies and extracts the package. Review the program paths next. No replacement helper starts and the program stays open until you confirm.
replacementStarting: Starting the replacement helper. Respond to Windows authorization if prompted. The program will exit and restart when the helper is ready.
replacementFailed: The update is incomplete. The current program has been kept open. Retry or cancel.
lastReplacementFailed: The previous replacement did not complete:
